description: Explain a diagnostic code (as the CLI's -explain does): what it means, how to resolve it and the specification clause or validation constraint behind it. Every diagnostic the `parse`, `diagnostics` and `workspace_diagnostics` tools report carries one of these codes. With no code, list every code with its one-line summary.

code.description: the diagnostic code, as a diagnostic's code field or a text line's error[code] carries it; empty lists every code with its one-line summary

name: explain_diagnostic

codes.description: with no code asked for, every code with its one-line summary

meaning.description: what the diagnostic means and how to resolve it

rule.description: for a member of a code family, the rule the member names

spec.description: the specification clause or validation constraint behind the rule

tier.description: the validation tier that emits it
